# Remix Icon assets for Signature Settings 3.0

Copyright Remix Design and contributors. Source: https://github.com/Remix-Design/RemixIcon/tree/8bc436bdd329cf342958d8effdd078bfa74354c6 (v4.6.0), Apache License 2.0, included in LICENSE. This fixed historical version predates the different current license; no assets are taken from the new license.

Original SVGs and SHA-256 inventory are retained here. Android VectorDrawable conversions preserve the filled paths and obtain their tint from Telegram theme colors. Modifications: hand.svg retains its inner palm/finger silhouette as a solid path, expanded with a 0.65-unit same-color stroke; ghost-fill omits its mouth cutout to match the two-eye reference. Horizontal equalizer-fill and file-3-fill paths are unchanged. Other paths are unchanged. No icons are used as the application logo or launcher identity.
